QF.id: VII Introduction to Securities Broking Operations_35

question.text: Which of the following is exempt from the mandatory PAN requirement for securities market transactions?

answer.text: Investors residing in the state of Sikkim
Investors with income below Rs. 5 lakh
All mutual fund investors under Rs. 50,000

explanation.text: The Logic: Exemptions from mandatory PAN: (1) Transactions on behalf of Central/State Government; (2) Court-appointed officials (Official Liquidator, Court Receiver); (3) Investors residing in Sikkim; (4) UN entities/multilateral agencies exempt from Indian taxes. The Trap: Institutional clients (FPIs, MFs, etc.) are NOT exempt from PAN — custodians must verify PAN and provide certified copies. E-PAN issued by CBDT is acceptable for FPIs. Note: The Sikkim exemption is part of the source-backed exemption list; the historical/tax rationale behind it is not detailed in the workbook pages checked.
